# Package catalog

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:catalog` from each package.json (`description` and `mariachi` fields). Do not edit. -->

31 packages. Status:

- **beta**: Hardened and covered by unit and integration tests. The API can still change before 1.0.
- **alpha**: Works, but hardening is in progress. Expect breaking changes.

## Foundation

| Package | Status | What it is | Use it when | Entry points |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`@mariachi/config`](../../config/README.md) | beta | Typed, validated configuration from the environment, plus secrets and feature flags. | Reading any setting or secret (never process.env directly) | `loadConfig`, `useConfig`, `readEnv`, `createSecrets`, `createFeatureFlags`, `DrizzleFeatureFlagStore` |
| [`@mariachi/core`](../../core/README.md) | beta | Context, typed errors, DI container, retry, idempotency and instrumentation primitives shared by every package. | Always: Context, MariachiError subclasses, container keys, retry, runOnce | `createContext`, `createContainer`, `KEYS`, `retry`, `runOnce` |
| `@mariachi/lifecycle` | beta | Composition root: bootstrap, ordered startup and shutdown, liveness/readiness/startup health. | Starting a process and managing resources that connect and disconnect | `bootstrap`, `bootstrapForTest`, `Lifecycle` |
| `@mariachi/observability` | beta | Logging, tracing, metrics and error tracking behind swappable adapters. | Logs, spans, metrics or error reporting | `createObservability`, `createLogger`, `createTracer`, `createMetrics` |

## HTTP and communication

| Package | Status | What it is | Use it when | Entry points |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `@mariachi/api-facade` | beta | Public HTTP API: controllers, Zod-validated routes, auth strategies, rate limits, OpenAPI and health endpoints. | Exposing REST endpoints to clients | `createApiServer`, `BaseController`, `bearerStrategy`, `apiKeyStrategy`, `serviceTokenStrategy` |
| `@mariachi/communication` | beta | Typed in-process procedure calls between controllers and services, with middleware, timeouts and scope checks. | Controllers calling business logic (communication.call), never importing services | `createCommunication`, `defineProcedure` |
| `@mariachi/server` | beta | HTTP transport on Fastify: request context, traceparent propagation, CORS, security headers, graceful close. | Building a custom HTTP surface; apps normally use api-facade or webhooks on top of it | `FastifyServerAdapter`, `contextFromRequest` |
| `@mariachi/webhooks` | beta | Inbound webhooks: signature verification over the raw body, dedup, direct or queued processing. | Receiving calls from Stripe, GitHub, auth providers or any signed sender | `WebhookServer`, `WebhookController`, `SignatureAuthController` |

## Data and storage

| Package | Status | What it is | Use it when | Entry points |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `@mariachi/cache` | beta | Redis or in-memory cache with stampede protection, SCAN-based invalidation, owned locks and an idempotency store. | Caching, distributed locks or request/job idempotency | `createCache`, `createLock`, `createRedisClient` |
| `@mariachi/database` | beta | Driver-agnostic schema DSL (defineTable), repository contract and seeds. | Declaring tables, indexes and seeds | `defineTable`, `column`, `index`, `defineSeed` |
| `@mariachi/database-postgres` | beta | Postgres via Drizzle: tenant-safe DrizzleRepository, transactions, cursor pagination, migrations from the DSL. | Reading and writing Postgres | `createPostgresDatabase`, `DrizzleRepository`, `withTransaction`, `compileSchema` |
| [`@mariachi/encryption`](../../encryption/README.md) | beta | Envelope encryption with key rotation (local keys, AWS KMS, GCP KMS). | Encrypting fields or blobs at rest | `createEncryption`, `LocalAdapter`, `AwsKmsAdapter`, `GcpKmsAdapter` |
| `@mariachi/schema` | beta | Every framework table (users, tenants, auth, billing, audit, ...) in the DSL, for apps to include in their schema. | Adding framework-owned tables to your migrations | `usersTable`, `tenantsTable` |
| [`@mariachi/search`](../../search/README.md) | beta | Full-text search on Typesense (or memory) with typed fields, alias-based reindexing and query analytics. | Search indexes over your data | `createSearch`, `DefaultSearch`, `SearchIndexer` |
| [`@mariachi/storage`](../../storage/README.md) | beta | Object storage (S3 and compatibles, local disk, memory) with path-safe keys, streaming, presigned uploads and signed URLs. | Storing uploads and files | `createStorage`, `DefaultStorage`, `handleSignedLocalRequest` |

## Events, jobs and realtime

| Package | Status | What it is | Use it when | Entry points |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `@mariachi/events` | beta | Domain events with envelopes, consumer groups, Redis Streams/NATS JetStream adapters, dead letters and a transactional outbox. | Reacting to something that happened in another module or process | `createEventBus`, `DefaultEvents`, `defineEvent`, `Outbox`, `OutboxRelay` |
| `@mariachi/jobs` | beta | Background jobs and cron on BullMQ with context propagation, retries, dedup and a dead-letter queue. | Work that runs later, on a schedule, or must survive restarts | `createJobQueue`, `defineJob`, `DefaultJobs` |
| `@mariachi/realtime` | beta | WebSockets with channel authorization, heartbeats, presence and cross-instance fanout. | Pushing live updates to connected clients | `DefaultRealtime`, `WSAdapter`, `createRealtimeInfra` |

## Security and access

| Package | Status | What it is | Use it when | Entry points |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`@mariachi/auth`](../../auth/README.md) | beta | JWT, OAuth, sessions, API keys with rotation and scopes, database-backed RBAC and brute-force protection. | Authenticating callers and checking permissions | `createAuth`, `createAuthorization`, `ApiKeyService`, `DrizzleRoleStore`, `JWTAdapter` |
| `@mariachi/auth-clerk` | alpha | Clerk token verification and Svix-signed webhooks. | Using Clerk as the identity provider | `createClerkAuth`, `ClerkWebhookController` |
| `@mariachi/auth-fusionauth` | alpha | FusionAuth JWT verification (JWKS) and webhook verification. | Using FusionAuth as the identity provider | `createFusionAuthAuth`, `FusionAuthWebhookHandler` |
| [`@mariachi/rate-limit`](../../rate-limit/README.md) | beta | Rate limiting on Redis or memory: sliding window, fixed window and token bucket, with per-tenant tiers. | Throttling callers (api-facade wires it per route) or metering per-tenant quotas | `createRateLimiter`, `DefaultRateLimiting` |
| `@mariachi/tenancy` | beta | Tenant resolution (subdomain, header, token) that fails closed. | Multi-tenant apps resolving the tenant per request | `createTenancy`, `createTenantResolver`, `createTenancyMiddleware` |
